extension.summary: Auto-applies XStream Player + TMDb Bingie Helper fixes
extension.description: Runs once at Kodi startup. Wires TMDb Bingie Helper's player config to XStream Player, patches known XStream Player bugs (series ID lookup, provider name-prefix cleanup, EPG notification spam), and sets XStream Player as the default player so Discover/search play directly without a chooser dialog. Safe to re-run — checks before changing anything, and will not touch a different XStream Player version than the one these patches were built against, to avoid corrupting it.
extension.news: 1.2.3 - Two Continue Watching fixes: posters now always prefer the clean TMDb/provider poster over whatever raw icon got saved at play time (previously only used as a fallback when nothing was saved at all, which let odd, badly-cropped episode stills through for some shows), and episode tiles now show "Season X - Episode Y" in the hero panel again -- extracted for free from the raw provider name before it gets cleaned for display, so cleaning the messy name no longer means losing which episode this actually is. 1.2.2 - New Arabic Movies/TV Shows rows still not showing on some devices (e.g. a user's Android TV box, despite an identical skin version) even after reinstalling: the patch matched all 4 widget variables (2 slots x Content/Name) as one combined block, so any single mismatch anywhere in that block -- even a harmless whitespace difference -- silently failed all 4 together. Each variable is now matched and patched independently, so a partial mismatch no longer blocks everything, and the log now names exactly which variable failed if one still does. 1.2.1 - Episode lists (e.g. opening a show's season) now show per-episode watch progress as a strip on the tile: a full bar for completed episodes (already worked, driven by watch history), and now also a partial bar for episodes stopped partway through, using the real saved resume position -- previously only fully-watched episodes showed anything. The add-on now also patches XStream Player's history.py (a new file, alongside addon.py) to add the lookup this needed. 1.2.0 - Fixed the white focus-selector border disappearing specifically on Continue Watching tiles: the Home screen's fixed focus-frame required a non-empty ListItem.Label to show at all, which Continue Watching tiles intentionally don't have (no title text). Removed that requirement from all 9 style-variant conditions so the border now shows consistently on every row. 1.1.9 - Two fixes: the dark bottom panel visible on every tile even with no title text was the title-panel background rendering regardless of whether there's a label -- now suppressed whenever the label is empty. Also switched the progress bar from yellow to the skin's own BingieProgressBarColor (already Netflix red, same color the existing hero-panel resume bar uses), instead of a hardcoded color. 1.1.8 - Continue Watching now shows clean TMDb/provider-metadata names and posters instead of the raw (often messy) provider name saved at play time -- e.g. "Dexter: Resurrection" instead of "AR-SUBS: Dexter: Resurrection (2025) (US)". Cache-only lookups (movies via the existing per-item VOD info cache, series via the already-cached catalog list), so this never blocks on a fresh network call during a Home load; falls back to a provider-prefix-stripped version of the raw name when no cached match exists yet. 1.1.7 - Fixed 1.1.6: the new progress bar never actually showed on tiles, because it was painted before the poster's title-panel overlay, which sits on top and hid it completely. Moved it to render after that overlay instead (a separate insertion point in widget_layout_poster, not inside the poster panel itself), so it now shows correctly. 1.1.6 - Continue Watching redesign: movies and episodes are now mixed into one chronological list (most recently watched first) instead of grouped/split by type; item names are no longer shown as text; and a thin yellow progress bar now renders on each tile instead of a percentage label, matching a Netflix-style look. The bar is deliberately approximate, not exact. 1.1.5 - Fixed 1.1.4: the New Arabic Movies/TV Shows rows never actually appeared, because they were inserted into script-skinshortcuts-includes.xml, which gets silently regenerated by script.skinshortcuts's own build process (confirmed: wiped within minutes on a real device). Now repurposes the existing 2nd/3rd Home widget slots instead, the same persistent mechanism Continue Watching already uses successfully. 1.1.4 - Added two new Home screen rows, "New Arabic Movies" and "New Arabic TV Shows", pulling directly from specific catalog categories (this setup's "افلام عربية حديثة" and "يعرض الآن عربي"), positioned right after Continue Watching. 1.1.3 - The 1.1.0 Continue Watching fix only reached the Movies/TV Show category pages, not the actual Home screen -- those turned out to be a completely separate widget mechanism from Home's own. Home's real first row (already designed to show "in progress" content, same as the category-page rows) now points at XStream Player's combined continue-watching feed (movies and episodes together) when the local library is empty. 1.1.2 - Fixed two Continue Watching issues: the single-type Movie/TV Show Hub rows were still showing an unnecessary "Movies"/"Series" section-divider tile meant only for a combined list, and items with no recorded icon (common for older watch-history entries) showed a blank generic placeholder instead of any thumbnail at all -- movies now check the small per-item info cache first, everything else falls back to a proper default icon. 1.1.1 - Fixed a variable-shadowing bug in movie/series category browsing: a cast-list loop reused the same variable name as the item's own title, silently overwriting it with the last actor's name. This corrupted favorites labels, watch history, and even the played title/OSD for any movie/show with cast data, whenever it was opened by browsing a category (search results were unaffected). Fixes garbled entries like a cast list showing up as a "movie name" in Continue Watching. 1.1.0 - Adds a real "Continue Watching" home screen banner. The Bingie skin's home page already has Movie/TV Show rows designed to show in-progress content, but they only read Kodi's local library, which stays empty for a plugin-only IPTV setup, so they fell back to generic TMDb "Trending" placeholders instead of anything personal. Those rows now use XStream Player's own continue-watching data (movies and episodes, with real resume position, across all profiles) so what's actually still-in-progress on the IPTV catalog shows up right on Home. 1.0.9 - Arabic search results were showing broken-looking "Series"/"Live TV" tiles mixed into the poster grid -- those were the combined search's own section dividers, not designed for this grid layout. Arabic search now gets dedicated Movies and Series rows instead of one mixed list, matching how the skin already presents other search results. Migrates automatically from the 1.0.6 single-block patch. 1.0.8 - Episode lists were showing a blank/generic thumbnail whenever a provider has no per-episode still (common for many Arabic-language series) -- episodes now fall back to the show's own poster. Also fixed the previous 1.0.7 fanart fallback to use the real backdrop image the provider actually supplies (confirmed present for both movies and series) instead of stretching the poster. 1.0.7 - Search result info screens (movies and series) were showing a blank backdrop and no plot/creator text, since XStream Player's own search never set a fanart image or series plot on result items. Now falls back to the poster as a backdrop (Xtream's API has no separate wide image) and fills in the plot text that was already being fetched but unused. 1.0.6 - Typing Arabic into the main search box now searches your IPTV catalog directly (movies, series, and live channels) instead of TMDb, since TMDb rarely has Arabic-language IPTV content indexed at all. English/Latin search is unchanged. Patches the Bingie skin's search include by exact content match, so it safely no-ops instead of risking corruption if a skin update changes that section. 1.0.5 - Fixed the Live TV home shortcut sometimes disappearing after a full restart (script.skinshortcuts can resync its own shortcuts file shortly after boot and silently undo our addition). All checks now recheck and self-heal every 5 minutes for the life of the Kodi session, not just once at startup. 1.0.4 - Fixed Live TV guide/search always being empty: vendors the "defusedxml" library so epg.py's own safer XML parser is used instead of its fallback, which wrongly rejected any XMLTV feed with a standard DOCTYPE (nearly all of them). Also adds a "Live TV" home menu shortcut automatically if the skin's shortcuts are set up. 1.0.3 - Fixed wrong-show matches for series with multiple regional/year variants sharing a name (e.g. "The Office" US 2005 vs the 2024 AU reboot) by requiring an exact showname+year match before falling back to a picker, same as the movie fix 1.0.2 - Fixed a crash on Android when backing up/replacing addon.py (shutil.copy2's metadata copy is refused by Android's storage layer; switched to a plain content copy) 1.0.1 - If the fix-check itself crashes, it now shows the full error directly on screen (no log file/uploader needed) 1.0.0 - Initial release
